decision.association: Repairs constructed matching defect; broad accuracy benefit not established

protocol.radar: Off per user; only saved data and local isolated ROS tests
protocol.limits: Previously examined room recording with range proxies; quiet captures and controlled synthetic tracker-stage inputs. No independent physical multi-person validation or obstacle-layer evaluation.
protocol.timing_limits: Tracker calls only, variants sequential, other host jobs active; no relative speedup or end-to-end latency claim.

walk.scope: Full independent tracker rollouts on identical point-stage outputs; current-scan display not accumulated.
walk.limits: Single previously examined room recording, range proxies rather than independent annotations; no DDS, acquisition/render latency or obstacle evaluation.
walk.absent_phase_limit: Interior of historical 62-82 s absence interval, trimmed to 64-80 s; no camera annotation. Report all tracks, not identity accuracy.

static.scope: Full independent tracker rollouts on identical point-stage outputs; current-scan display not accumulated.
static.limits: Single previously examined room recording, range proxies rather than independent annotations; no DDS, acquisition/render latency or obstacle evaluation.
static.absent_phase_limit: Interior of historical 62-82 s absence interval, trimmed to 64-80 s; no camera annotation. Report all tracks, not identity accuracy.

recovered_quiet.scope: Full independent tracker rollouts on identical point-stage outputs; current-scan display not accumulated.
recovered_quiet.limits: Single previously examined room recording, range proxies rather than independent annotations; no DDS, acquisition/render latency or obstacle evaluation.
recovered_quiet.absent_phase_limit: Interior of historical 62-82 s absence interval, trimmed to 64-80 s; no camera annotation. Report all tracks, not identity accuracy.

synthetic.scope: Synthetic tracker-only measurements, no point rejection, ego fit or sensor model.
synthetic.limits: Controlled mechanisms, not a forecast of physical crossing performance. ID changes include reinitialization after gaps. No parameter search over seeds.

source_equivalence.change: Line wrapping only; replay hashes preserved; final synthetic run hashes current source.
